verdict.rationale: Nitrokey makes hardware security keys and HSMs (FIDO2, OpenPGP, PIV, NetHSM). It has no user-authored automations or workflows, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this product type. Firmware releases and NetHSM API versioning concern device firmware and API stability, not user automations, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
